trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

**Deploy:**
- checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy across all 3 production regions with an 18% error rate. Hotfix **v2.3.2** had never been in production, so the deploy routed to the change manager per policy — it was approved ("Approved. Looks right.") and rolled out to **us-east, us-west, and eu-west**.
- Post-deploy, the service is **healthy in all regions** with error rate dropped to **0.2%**.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV3 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions") recording the change, old (18%) and new (0.2%) error rates, and the approval. The on-call engineer has been paged.
